provenance.bg.raised: spec: base02 = background highlights (only raised tone)
provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.06:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is invisible here, 1.00:1 vs inactive selection 1.15:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.default: spec: 'body text is base0 on base03 (not base00)'
provenance.fg.faint: spec: base01 = comments (only tone dimmer than body)
provenance.fg.on-accent: choice: Solarized accents are mid-luminance; base03 gives the highest ratio on them in both modes
provenance.fg.title: spec: base1 = optional emphasized content
provenance.accent.primary: choice: Solarized identity hue; no accent reaches 4.5:1 in light mode
provenance.accent.secondary: choice: distinct from blue and from info cyan
provenance.status.error: choice: accent red (README defines no UI roles)

notes: Terminal slots: solarized/xresources (same ANSI assignment in dark and light): 8 = base03 (= background, invisible), 9 = orange, 10-12/14 = monotones base01/base00/base0/base1, 13 = violet, 15 = base3. ansi16 overrides route faint text and borders to slot 10 (base01).
Discrepancy: altercation iterm2 files use color-managed values (bg #001e27); kept the canonical README/xresources hex.

Solarized has two text tones per mode: body base0 (4.75:1) and secondary base01 (2.79:1). fg.muted and fg.faint are both base01 and fail their floors; use fg.title (base1) for emphasis to keep hierarchy.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): accent.secondary -> '13' (slot 5 #d33682 is not the #6c71c4 hue; slot 13 = #6c71c4, 3.43:1) | mark -> '13' (slot 5 #d33682 is not the #6c71c4 hue; slot 13 = #6c71c4, 3.43:1) | diff.changed -> '6' (slot 6 is the closer match to #2aa198; slot 6 = #2aa198, 4.75:1) | fg.muted -> '7 dim' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.39:1; now 4.66:1) | fg.faint -> '7 dim' (default '8' resolves to 1.00:1; now 4.66:1) | keyhint.desc -> '7 dim' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.39:1; now 4.66:1) | tab.inactive.fg -> '7 dim' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.39:1; now 4.66:1) | border.default -> 'default dim' (default '8' resolves to 1.00:1; now 2.39:1) | scrollbar.track -> 'default dim' (default '8' resolves to 1.00:1; now 2.39:1)
